fullText.simplified:
第29章、另一个名字

    高静在弹钢琴，一看到李河就高兴地说：“你来了！中午我给你打电话了，但是你没有接，工作不顺利吗？”
    李河看着她，过了很久才说：“高静，你不爱你先生吗？”
    高静的笑没有了，她问：“你说什么？”
    李河笑了一下，但他的样子比哭还难看。他说：“你应该还有另一个名字吧？你就是大侦探小说家春草，对不对？”
    高静的脸已经白了，她过了一会儿才说：“我听不懂，你在说什么？”
    李河看着高静，笑了笑：“没关系，我慢慢说，你会听得懂的。你就是作家春草，四年前你先生去国外出差后，你开始用春草的名字写小说。小说很快就火了，这本来是一件好事，但因为一个重要的原因，你不能告诉大家你就是春草。这个重要的原因就是张一南。张一南是你以前的男朋友，你不想再见他，也不想被他找到，所以你不能让大家知道春草就是高静。我不知道我是不是应该高兴，因为这说明，你对我说的你中学时候的故事是真的。”
    “为了不让大家知道春草是高静，你想了很多方法。大家都说春草没有电话和电子邮件，春草讨厌和人交流，大家都找不到春草，很少有人能见到春草，这些都是你用的方法，没有人怀疑过春草其实是另外一个人。著名记者小九见过你，但他见的只是你花钱找的演员，不是真正的你，对吗？找演员来帮自己和记者见面，这真是个聪明的主意。只要收了钱的演员不说，小九就永远不会知道他见的不是真正的春草，这个演员的表演很成功。”
fullText.traditional:
第29章、另一個名字

    高靜在彈鋼琴，一看到李河就高興地說：“你來了！中午我給你打電話了，但是你沒有接，工作不順利嗎？”
    李河看著她，過了很久才說：“高靜，你不愛你先生嗎？”
    高靜的笑沒有了，她問：“你說什麼？”
    李河笑了一下，但他的樣子比哭還難看。他說：“你應該還有另一個名字吧？你就是大偵探小說家春草，對不對？”
    高靜的臉已經白了，她過了一會兒才說：“我聽不懂，你在說什麼？”
    李河看著高靜，笑了笑：“沒關係，我慢慢說，你會聽得懂的。你就是作家春草，四年前你先生去國外出差後，你開始用春草的名字寫小說。小說很快就火了，這本來是一件好事，但因為一個重要的原因，你不能告訴大家你就是春草。這個重要的原因就是張一南。張一南是你以前的男朋友，你不想再見他，也不想被他找到，所以你不能讓大家知道春草就是高靜。我不知道我是不是應該高興，因為這說明，你對我說的你中學時候的故事是真的。”
    “為了不讓大家知道春草是高靜，你想了很多方法。大家都說春草沒有電話和電子郵件，春草討厭和人交流，大家都找不到春草，很少有人能見到春草，這些都是你用的方法，沒有人懷疑過春草其實是另外一個人。著名記者小九見過你，但他見的只是你花錢找的演員，不是真正的你，對嗎？找演員來幫自己和記者見面，這真是個聰明的主意。只要收了錢的演員不說，小九就永遠不會知道他見的不是真正的春草，這個演員的表演很成功。”

sentences.traditional: 這本來是一件好事，但因為一個重要的原因，你不能告訴大家你就是春草。
sentences.pinyin: zhè běn lái shì yí jiàn hǎo shì dàn yīn wèi yí ge zhòng yào de yuán yīn nǐ bù néng gào su dà jiā nǐ jiù shì chūn cǎo

sentences.traditional: 張一南是你以前的男朋友，你不想再見他，也不想被他找到，
sentences.pinyin: zhāng yī nán shì nǐ yǐ qián de nán péng you nǐ bù xiǎng zài jiàn tā yě bù xiǎng bèi tā zhǎo dào
sentences.english: Zhang Yinan is your ex-boyfriend. You didn’t want to see him again and didn’t want to be found by him.

sentences.simplified: 所以你不能让大家知道春草就是高静。
sentences.traditional: 所以你不能讓大家知道春草就是高靜。

sentences.english: So you couldn’t tell everyone that Chun Cao is Gao Jing.

sentences.pinyin: wǒ bù zhī dào wǒ shì bú shì yīng gāi gāo xìng yīn wèi zhè shuō míng nǐ duì wǒ shuō de nǐ zhōng xué shí hou de gù shi shì zhēn de
sentences.english: I don’t know if I should be happy or not. Because this shows that the story you told me from high school is true.”

sentences.simplified: “为了不让大家知道春草是高静，你想了很多方法。
sentences.traditional: “為了不讓大家知道春草是高靜，你想了很多方法。
sentences.pinyin: wèi le bú ràng dà jiā zhī dào chūn cǎo shì gāo jìng nǐ xiǎng le hěn duō fāng fǎ
sentences.english: “You thought of many ways to stop people from finding out that Chun Cao is Gao Jing.

sentences.simplified: 大家都说春草没有电话和电子邮件，春草讨厌和人交流，
sentences.traditional: 大家都說春草沒有電話和電子郵件，春草討厭和人交流，
sentences.pinyin: dà jiā dōu shuō chūn cǎo méi yǒu diàn huà hé diàn zǐ yóu jiàn chūn cǎo tǎo yàn hé rén jiāo liú
sentences.english: Everyone said that Chun Cao didn’t have a phone or email, and Chun Cao hated interacting with other people.

sentences.simplified: 大家都找不到春草，很少有人能见到春草，这些都是你用的方法，
sentences.traditional: 大家都找不到春草，很少有人能見到春草，這些都是你用的方法，
sentences.pinyin: dà jiā dōu zhǎo bú dào chūn cǎo hěn shǎo yǒu rén néng jiàn dào chūn cǎo zhè xiē dōu shì nǐ yòng de fāng fǎ
sentences.english: Nobody could find Chun Cao, and very few people were able to meet Chun Cao. These are all methods you used.

sentences.simplified: 没有人怀疑过春草其实是另外一个人。
sentences.traditional: 沒有人懷疑過春草其實是另外一個人。
sentences.pinyin: méi yǒu rén huái yí guò chūn cǎo qí shí shì lìng wài yí ge rén
sentences.english: Nobody suspected that Chun Cao was actually another person.

sentences.simplified: 著名记者小九见过你，但他见的只是你花钱找的演员，不是真正的你，对吗？
sentences.traditional: 著名記者小九見過你，但他見的只是你花錢找的演員，不是真正的你，對嗎？
sentences.pinyin: zhù míng jì zhě xiǎo jiǔ jiàn guò nǐ dàn tā jiàn de zhǐ shì nǐ huā qián zhǎo de yǎn yuán bú shì zhēn zhèng de nǐ duì ma
sentences.english: The famous reporter Xiaojiu has seen you before, but what he saw was simply an actor you paid and not the real you. Am I right?

sentences.simplified: 找演员来帮自己和记者见面，这真是个聪明的主意。
sentences.traditional: 找演員來幫自己和記者見面，這真是個聰明的主意。
sentences.pinyin: zhǎo yǎn yuán lái bāng zì jǐ hé jì zhě jiàn miàn zhè zhēn shi ge cōng ming de zhǔ yi
sentences.english: You found an actor to meet a journalist on your behalf. This was a really clever idea.

sentences.simplified: 只要收了钱的演员不说，小九就永远不会知道他见的不是真正的春草，
sentences.traditional: 只要收了錢的演員不說，小九就永遠不會知道他見的不是真正的春草，
sentences.pinyin: zhǐ yào shōu le qián de yǎn yuán bù shuō xiǎo jiǔ jiù yǒng yuǎn bú huì zhī dào tā jiàn de bú shì zhēn zhèng de chūn cǎo
sentences.english: As long as the paid actor didn’t say anything, Xiaojiu would never know that the person he saw wasn’t the real Chun Cao.

sentences.simplified: 这个演员的表演很成功。”
sentences.traditional: 這個演員的表演很成功。”
sentences.pinyin: zhè ge yǎn yuán de biǎo yǎn hěn chéng gōng
sentences.english: The actor’s performance was very successful.”

sentence_translations: Chapter 29: Another Name
Gao Jing was playing the piano. When she saw Li He, she said happily, ..
.. “You’ve come! At noon I gave you a call, but you didn’t pick up. Is work not going well?”
Li He looked at her, and after a long time finally said, “Gao Jing, do you not love your husband?”
Gao Jing’s smile disappeared. She asked, “What are you saying?”
Li He smiled briefly, but his face looked worse than if he were to cry.
He said, “You have another name, don’t you? You are the great detective novelist Chun Cao. Am I right?”
Gao Jing’s face had become white. After a while, she finally said, “I don’t understand. What are you saying?
Li He looked at Gao Jing and smiled: “Never mind, I will explain it slowly. You will understand.
You are the author Chun Cao. Four years ago after your husband went abroad on business, you started using the name Chun Cao to write novels.
The novels very quickly became popular.
This of course was a good thing, but because of one important reason, you couldn’t tell everyone that you were Chun Cao.
That important reason is Zhang Yinan.
Zhang Yinan is your ex-boyfriend. You didn’t want to see him again and didn’t want to be found by him.
So you couldn’t tell everyone that Chun Cao is Gao Jing.
I don’t know if I should be happy or not. Because this shows that the story you told me from high school is true.”
“You thought of many ways to stop people from finding out that Chun Cao is Gao Jing.
Everyone said that Chun Cao didn’t have a phone or email, and Chun Cao hated interacting with other people.
Nobody could find Chun Cao, and very few people were able to meet Chun Cao. These are all methods you used.
Nobody suspected that Chun Cao was actually another person.
The famous reporter Xiaojiu has seen you before, but what he saw was simply an actor you paid and not the real you. Am I right?
You found an actor to meet a journalist on your behalf. This was a really clever idea.
As long as the paid actor didn’t say anything, Xiaojiu would never know that the person he saw wasn’t the real Chun Cao.
The actor’s performance was very successful.”
